name: Degrees Of Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that sin varies in severity and consequences, as seen in God's declaration of the grievousness of Sodom and Gomorrah's sin (Genesis 18:20) and Jesus' teaching that different expressions of anger carry escalating judgments (Matthew 5:22). The parable of the servant who knowingly disobeys his master illustrates that greater knowledge and willful disobedience result in harsher punishment (Luke 12:47), while John 19:11 highlights that those who act against God's purposes bear greater guilt. Though all have sinned and fall short of God's glory (Romans 3:23), the ultimate consequence of sin is death, contrasted with the gift of eternal life through Christ (Romans 6:23).
